change.description: Add HTML sanitizer for translated message resources
change.author: Cristian Sotomayor

findings.title: Lithuanian totpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `totpStep1` in the Lithuanian account bundle is now `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, which is Italian. Lithuanian users will see an Italian sentence on the TOTP setup screen, and the verifier cannot catch it. Replace it with a Lithuanian translation of the English `Install one of the following applications on your mobile:`. If none is available, delete the key so it falls back to English.

findings.title: Lithuanian loginTotpStep1 replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `loginTotpStep1` is now `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`, which is Italian. It appears on the login TOTP setup page for Lithuanian users. Use a Lithuanian translation, or remove the key so it falls back to English.

findings.title: zh_CN totpStep1 uses Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: The new value `在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：` is Traditional Chinese (the zh_TW script: 手機, 安裝, 應用程式). This file is the Simplified Chinese bundle, and the neighbouring keys such as `totpStep2` are Simplified. Simplified-Chinese users will see a Traditional-script sentence. Use the Simplified form, e.g. `在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：`.

findings.title: Account UI message switched from i18next `{{n}}` to Java `{n}`/choice syntax
findings.body: This bundle is rendered by i18next (`js/apps/account-ui/src/i18n.ts:25`, default `{{ }}` interpolation). Server validation errors reach it through `t(key, {0:…,1:…,2:…})` in `js/libs/ui-shared/src/user-profile/utils.ts:74-86`. Every other placeholder in this file is `{{0}}`-style. With `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2}` and `{2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}`, i18next substitutes nothing, so the user sees the literal text `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,...}.`. i18next has no `choice` syntax. The original `{{0}}`/`{{1}}`/`{{2}}` form never needed changing, because the verifier strips `<!-- -->` and the old string had no `<`. I did not find any server-side conversion of `{{ }}` to `{ }` for this endpoint (searched `services/src/main/java`). Restore `{{0}}`/`{{1}}`/`{{2}}` here, and use an i18next-compatible form for the plural, such as `value(s)`. The same applies to `js/apps/admin-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v2/admin/messages/messages_en.properties:3138`.

findings.title: Admin UI message switched from i18next `{{n}}` to Java `{n}`/choice syntax
findings.body: The admin UI uses i18next with default `{{ }}` interpolation (`js/apps/admin-ui/src/i18n/i18n.ts:13`). The other 25 `{{0}}` placeholders in this file use that form. `{0}`/`{1}`/`{2}` and `{2,choice,…}` will be shown literally when `error-invalid-multivalued-size` is raised, because i18next only replaces `{{key}}`. The Java `MessageFormat` choice syntax belongs only in the server-side `themes/.../admin/messages/messages_en.properties`. Revert this line to the previous `{{0}}`/`{{1}}`/`{{2}}` form. See the account-ui comment for the evidence.

findings.title: English counterpart lookup is fragile and fails with a bare RuntimeException
findings.body: The English path is derived with `replaceAll("resources-community", "resources")` over the whole absolute path, so any checkout directory containing that string is rewritten too. The second regex then rewrites the first `_xx.properties` suffix it finds. If the English file does not exist, `verifySafeHtml` throws an unchecked `RuntimeException` (line 79) instead of the `MojoExecutionException`/message list the rest of `verify()` uses, so the build fails with a stack trace rather than a validation message. The plugin runs for every module that configures it, via `js/pom.xml:55`. Consider replacing only the path segment, then reporting a missing English file through `messages` or a `MojoExecutionException`.

findings.title: Policies and patterns are per-instance fields; method name has a typo
findings.body: `POLICY_SOME_HTML`, `POLICY_NO_HTML` and `HTML_TAGS` are named like constants but are non-static instance fields. They are rebuilt for every `VerifyMessageProperties` instance, and the Mojo creates one per messages file (`ThemeVerifierMojo.java:51`). Make them `private static final`. `santizeAnchors` (line 150) should be `sanitizeAnchors`. The `key` parameter of that method is also unused.

contracts.action: verify() now calls verifySafeHtml(), which reads the translation file and its English counterpart as PropertyResourceBundles and sanitizes every value
contracts.equivalent_path: verifyNoDuplicateKeys at VerifyMessageProperties.java:174, called from ThemeVerifierMojo.execute, which collects returned messages and fails the build with MojoFailureException
contracts.before_after: The duplicate-keys check appends to `messages`. The new check also appends to `messages` (line 111), and the Mojo aggregates them at ThemeVerifierMojo.java:54-55, so reporting is the same. The one difference is that an unreadable file or missing English file throws RuntimeException (lines 70, 79) instead of MojoExecutionException.
contracts.visible_effect: The build fails with a 'Validation errors' message listing keys with illegal HTML or changed anchors. No runtime product behaviour changes.
contracts.failure_mode: A missing `messages_en.properties` counterpart aborts the whole plugin execution with an unchecked exception and a stack trace. No messages are collected.

contracts.action: The English error-invalid-multivalued-size string in the account-ui and admin-ui bundles changes from `{{0}}` to `{0}` plus `{2,choice,...}`
contracts.equivalent_path: Every other placeholder in the same bundles, e.g. error-invalid-length-too-short, uses `{{n}}`. The server error is rendered via setUserProfileServerError in js/libs/ui-shared/src/user-profile/utils.ts:64-90 with i18next `t(key, {0,1,2})`.
contracts.before_after: Before, i18next substituted the `{{n}}` placeholders. After, `{n}` and the choice expression are left literal because i18next only interpolates `{{ }}` and has no choice syntax.
contracts.visible_effect: Users hitting a multivalued size violation in the account or admin UI see raw `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2}` and `{2,choice,...}` in the field error.
contracts.failure_mode: Silent wrong text; no error is logged.

contracts.action: Server-side (login/admin) error-invalid-multivalued-size now uses a Java MessageFormat choice on {2}
contracts.equivalent_path: linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit.* in the email bundle already uses `{0,choice,...}`. MultiValueValidator.addError passes Long min and Long max to ValidationError.
contracts.before_after: The params are numeric (Long), so MessageFormat choice formatting works. The Slovak fix of `{1,choice...}` to `{2,choice...}` in the second slot is also correct.
contracts.visible_effect: Singular and plural are rendered correctly on the server-rendered pages.

summary:
The new verifier logic looks sound and the tests exercise it. I found three problems in the message changes.

- **Lithuanian:** `totpStep1` (account) and `loginTotpStep1` (login) now contain Italian text.
- **Simplified Chinese:** the account `totpStep1` in the `zh_CN` bundle now contains Traditional Chinese text.
- **JS UIs:** the English `error-invalid-multivalued-size` in account-ui and admin-ui was changed from i18next `{{n}}` to Java `{n}`/choice syntax. i18next won't interpolate that, so users would see the raw placeholders. This one rests on my reading of the i18next setup and the server endpoint, so confidence is medium.

I also left two minor cleanup notes on the verifier. I only read the code, so none of this was built or run.
